capabilities.NAME: Candidate and validation provenance before release
capabilities.BLOCKER: V10 certifies generated candidate source/time/account provenance. V16 fixed the ConfluenceEngineV2 contract defect V15 found (PRODUCTION_CONFLUENCE_WIRING=GREEN): the real app.py walk-forward wiring (BacktestCandidateFactoryV2 + build_strategy_backtest_pipeline + ParameterizedStrategyRunnerV2) now runs on real arbitrary candles without raising. V16 also proved, mathematically and empirically, that this repaired wiring cannot yet reach a CERTIFIED grade: TradeQualityEngineV1 requires a ConfluenceEngineV2 grade of A+ to reach its 85-point approval threshold, and grade A+ (score>=90) is unreachable while liquidity_score/fvg_score/market_regime_score stay at an honest neutral 0.5 (no liquidity/FVG/market-regime detector is wired into this offline runner). Real liquidity/FVG/market-regime detection must be added (V17) before this wiring can produce a genuine CERTIFIED arbitrary-dataset result.
capabilities.ASSESSMENT: V10 certifies generated candidate source/time/account provenance. V15 certifies arbitrary-dataset empirical evidence (real Walk Forward + real Monte Carlo, no Fake* doubles) reaches StrategyCertificationPipelineV2 correctly, is reproducible, and fails closed on insufficient evidence via a substitute (non-production) adapter, since the real production wiring crashed at the time. V16 repaired the actual production ConfluenceEngineV2 contract (one canonical authority, no fabricated inputs, no weakened validation) and proved the real app.py wiring now runs end-to-end on arbitrary data; it also proved that wiring cannot yet reach CERTIFIED because of a separate, deeper capability gap (no liquidity/FVG/market-regime detection in the offline runner). MVP-024 stays PARTIAL until that capability gap is closed and the repaired production wiring is certified with a genuine CERTIFIED result.
